answer: Bonded escrows make identities costly to operate. If evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, penalties scale as O(k²), charging for pairwise coordination rather than headcount alone. Correlated proofs also trigger asymmetric depreciation: the protocol applies an exponential loss multiplier to seized collateral, making a detected swarm’s capital loss escalate sharply. A prism of attestations and a quartz audit trail anchor attribution, so splitting one operator across aliases cannot dilute liability.
